commits.summary: Resubmit the CBMC 6.11.0 source-reading job with a grep that matches (verification pending)
commits.body:
Job 20261106-192959-cbmc-6-11-0-s-source-times-runtime-post failed (VF-004) because its display grep '^decision_proceduret::resultt run_property_decider' matched nothing in CBMC 6.11.0's bmc_util.cpp, and under pipefail that ended the step before any check ran. The new job prints run_property_decider with 'grep -n -B2 -A45 "run_property_decider("', and also the 'Runtime decision procedure' line and the post_processing_done guard. The display greps print '(no match)' rather than failing, so the step always reaches the three unchanged grep -q checks ('Runtime Solver', 'Runtime Post-process', 'finish_eager_conversion'). The job validates and the step passes bash -n; it was not run here, since it fetches from the network.

Verification pending: job 20261106-194328-cbmc-6-11-0-s-source-times-runtime-post (verification/jobs/). VF-004 closes when it passes.

commits.summary: run-verification skill: say how to wait for a background runner
commits.body: Step 2 told the managing agent to start 'pipeline.py run' in the background but not how to wait for it. A verification-loop session improvised 'while pgrep -f "pipeline.py run"; do sleep 10; done' and an 'until ! pgrep -f ...' loop; each matched its own command line, so the session hung for 8 minutes after the runner had finished, until it was killed by hand at 19:49. Step 2 now says to wait for the background task's completion notification or poll 'pipeline.py status' until it shows 'running: 0', and never to wait with pgrep -f on a pattern. A documentation change only; checked that 'status' prints a 'running:' line.
